note: Textbook on four of five criteria: owns a Rolex trading business with a $20,000 biweekly payroll and two adult children running it, has cash and refuses consumer financing, is visibly not deconditioned (trains most evenings, squats, intervals, long history as a lineman and carpenter), and wants pure refinement — belly fat and arm definition on an already strong base. The fifth criterion, neglected_health, is the awkward one: he is the opposite of neglectful, running annual Lifeline screenings, full Quest panels and genetic testing, and having raised his own testosterone from ~300 to ~550 unaided. It is scored as a match because the criterion tests severity and he is nowhere near a health crisis, but he is arguably better informed about his own health than the programme is. Worth flagging for the central rollup that a core-ICP buyer at full expected price was nonetheless sold a $1,200 one-month trial — the ICP predicted the deal, the process gave away the revenue.
